name: lemon8/app/discover-tab-information-tabs
description: Returns the Editor's Picks and discover tab information from the Lemon8 mobile app. Use this endpoint to inspect curated featured categories and discover sections.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# Lemon8 Discover Editor Picks API Returns the Editor's Picks and discover tab sections shown in the Lemon8 mobile app. Each section carries a title, a banner image and a season of featured posts. The request takes no input parameters. ## Use cases - List the current Lemon8 editor campaigns, such as `Weekly Trends` and `girltalk`, with their banner images. - Collect featured posts and their authors from each campaign to see which creators Lemon8 promotes. - Track how campaign hashtags and season subtitles change from one call to the next. - Read the search phrases attached to featured posts to find topics tied to a campaign. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/lemon8/app/discover-tab-information-tabs" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "data": { "impression_id": "7703843302294030605", "informations": [ { "back_color": "", "banner_url": "https://p19-lemon8-va-sign.tiktokcdn-us.com/tos-maliva-i-tej9nj120t-us/7a69aeb45…", "has_more": true, "id": "7470802545074604087", "items": [], "offset": 10, "priority": 1062, "season": { "creator_intro": "", "creators": [], "has_more": true, "items": [ { "abstract": "

Since grad season is upon us I thought I show some of the poses and locations…", "aggr_type": 0, "anchor_list": [ { "anchor_type": 2, "biz_extra": "{\"word\":\"graduation photos ideas\",\"group_id\":\"950419280026140709\",\"score\":0.0038…", "icon_type": "square", "icon_url": "https://p16-lemon8-cross-sign.tiktokcdn-us.com/tos-alisg-i-2014-sg/10564e90b5d14…", "log_extra": "{\"anchor_type\":\"search\",\"sar_query\":\"graduation photos ideas\"}", "schema": "", "show_in_folded": true, "sub_title": "graduation photos ideas" } ], "app_transcode_rule": {}, "article_class": "Gallery", "article_sub_class": "normal", "article_type": 0, "article_url": "https://www.lemon8-app.com/@swagis4eva/7501417544423703086?user_id=7262344915936…" } ], "offset": 10, "season_id": "7503609246219503621", "season_num": 7, "season_subtitle": "It’s your moment to shine! Whether you’re tossing your cap, striking a power pos…" }, "sub_title": "#graduationpictures", "title": "Weekly Trends" } ] }, "message": "success", "server_time": "1793691390.56" } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data.informations[].title / data.informations[].sub_title` | Name of the editor section and its hashtag, for example `Weekly Trends` with `#graduationpictures`. | | `data.informations[].id` | ID of the section as a string. | | `data.informations[].banner_url` | Banner image URL for the section. | | `data.informations[].priority` | Number that sets the order of the sections. Lower values appear first in the sample. | | `data.informations[].has_more / data.informations[].offset` | Show whether the section has more posts and the offset value returned for it. | | `data.informations[].season.season_id / data.informations[].season.season_num` | ID and number of the current season of the campaign. | | `data.informations[].season.season_subtitle` | Short text that describes the campaign and what creators should post. | | `data.informations[].season.items[].article_url` | Link to a featured post on lemon8-app.com. The link holds the author handle and the post ID. | | `data.informations[].season.items[].article_class` | Type of the post, such as `Gallery` or `Video`. | | `data.informations[].season.items[].author.name / data.informations[].season.items[].author.user_unique_name` | Display name and handle of the post author. Author details such as `author_id` and `description` sit in the same object. | ## Notes - The top-level `items` list in each section is empty in the sample. Read the featured posts from `season.items[]` instead. - Some posts include `anchor_list[]`. Its `sub_title` holds a search phrase linked to the post. - Pass a post ID from `article_url` to [Lemon8 Post Details](/apis/lemon8/app/post-detail) to get the full post. - Pass a handle or author ID to [Lemon8 User Profile Details](/apis/lemon8/app/user-profile) to look at a creator. ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Lemon8 Discover Page Banners](/apis/lemon8/app/discover-banners): Returns the current promotional and featured banners displayed on the Lemon8 discover page. - [Lemon8 Discover Page Content](/apis/lemon8/app/discover-tab): Returns the main content featured on the Lemon8 discover tab. - [Lemon8 Hot Search Keywords](/apis/lemon8/app/hot-search-keywords): Returns trending search keywords and topics currently popular on Lemon8.
